sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Cleric:
Increases HP recovery effects of a healing Ability by XL.
Increases the target's max HP for 20 seconds by S. Recovers 5% of max HP every 5 seconds for 10 seconds.

[Activation]
When a healing Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Cleric.

[Activation Rate]
M
